name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana
summary: A scheme that provides collateral-free loans to non-farm micro and small enterprises through banks, NBFCs and microfinance institutions under the Shishu, Kishore and Tarun categories.

eligibility_clauses.text: The applicant must be 18 years of age or older.

entitlement_rules.text: Loan limits are tiered: Shishu up to Rs. 50000, Kishore up to Rs. 5 lakh and Tarun up to Rs. 10 lakh, based on the applicant's annual income.

appeal_hierarchy.description: First grievance at the bank branch.
Final grievance before the Banking Ombudsman.
